title: Road / curb / entrance snapping heuristics for real parking geometry

reuse_check.notes: The repository instructions require checking Referenss first. The directory was absent in this checkout, so implementation should reuse documented references and existing in-repo ports instead of copying unavailable local code.

official_docs_checked.name: OSM Street parking
official_docs_checked.observed_relevance: parking:left/right/both tags on highway ways; side is relative to way direction; supports one/both-side curb classification.

official_docs_checked.name: OSM parking key
official_docs_checked.observed_relevance: parking=* values on amenity=parking and parking entrances; entrance nodes are access evidence, not full facilities.

official_docs_checked.name: CurbLR
official_docs_checked.observed_relevance: curb regulations as GeoJSON LineString features with side/location/regulation properties.

official_docs_checked.name: OMF Curb Data Specification
official_docs_checked.observed_relevance: static/dynamic curb parking and access regulations, metrics and policy model.

official_docs_checked.name: A/B Street parking docs
official_docs_checked.observed_relevance: on-street parking as road lane divided by configurable spot length; lots/service aisles modeled separately.

official_docs_checked.name: PostGIS ST_OffsetCurve / ST_LineLocatePoint / ST_LineSubstring
official_docs_checked.observed_relevance: offset curb lines and linear referencing/cutting primitives for implementation.

confidence_bands.source_confidence: Reliability of upstream source, e.g. official ArcGIS/Socrata can be high.
confidence_bands.offer_confidence: Driver-facing trust that this is ordinary public parking now.

snapping_pipeline.name: input_classification
snapping_pipeline.summary: Classify physical facility, entrance, curb evidence point, curb rule boundary, road network candidate and exclusion/conflict feature before matching.

snapping_pipeline.name: side_of_street_assignment
rules: OSM parking:left/right/both is relative to way direction.
Official side/blockface fields override heuristic side.
Point clusters infer side by signed perpendicular distance.
Both-side evidence should split into two curb rows.

snapping_pipeline.name: road_side_vs_lot_interior_filtering
snapping_pipeline.summary: Remove/generated downgrade curb rows inside official lot/garage polygons and keep internal spaces as facility evidence.

snapping_pipeline.name: entrance_snapping_and_facility_association
snapping_pipeline.summary: Classify parking_entrance as garage_entrance, associate to nearby/contained physical facility, never count entrance as standalone offer.

snapping_pipeline.name: conflict_scoring_and_promotion_gate
snapping_pipeline.summary: Promote to default public layer only after semantics, access, geometry, conflicts and provenance pass thresholds.

reference_data_to_reuse.purpose: Regression fixtures for Miami Beach layer7 zones, layer3 spaces, meters and OSM entrance/private/customer candidates.
Official spaces/meters/lots/zones for road-side vs lot-interior filtering and source confidence separation.
NYC meter and parking sign Socrata sources for future sign-to-curb parser.
Seattle blockface FeatureServer as preferred official curb geometry source.

legal_and_authority_guardrails: Satellite/aerial/photo evidence may support review but must not become authoritative master geometry without license review and human/official confirmation.
Google Maps/Street View/Places can be used only as permitted discovery/matching/manual QA, not as cached ParkingUSA master geometry.
Payment app zone ids are payment evidence, not proof of physical availability.
User field evidence enters SourceObservation/conflict review first; it may downgrade confidence but should not silently overwrite official facts.
